units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: Planning the development of social infrastructure is based on the following principles:
units.label: The Social Sphere · “Planning the development of social infrastructure is based on…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: provision of infrastructure in anchor settlements in accordance with standards, including to ensure access to education, medical care, social care and cultural services and meet other needs of residents of adjacent territories;
units.label: The Social Sphere · “provision of infrastructure in anchor settlements in accordance…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: taking account of existing infrastructure, including private infrastructure, and the population’s needs in light of population density and transport accessibility of social infrastructure facilities, including the establishment of centers providing services, medical care, education and social care to several constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipalities;
units.label: The Social Sphere · “taking account of existing infrastructure, including private…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: taking account of planned capacity utilization when creating new infrastructure facilities, primarily expensive and highly specialized ones, to maximize the efficiency of their use and prevent excessive budget expenditure;
units.label: The Social Sphere · “taking account of planned capacity utilization when creating…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: taking account, when deciding to create or expand an infrastructure facility, of the population’s age and sex composition, migration flows, attractiveness as a place to live for families with children and young people, the demographic forecast for the territory, and personnel requirements of investment projects implemented or planned in the territory; that demographic forecast and those personnel requirements must be reflected in the territory’s strategic planning documents.
units.label: The Social Sphere · “taking account, when deciding to create or expand an…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: A specific feature of planning sports infrastructure development is prioritizing facilities for mass-participation sport aimed at increasing the share of citizens regularly engaging in physical culture and sport.
units.label: The Social Sphere · “A specific feature of planning sports infrastructure…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: Specific features of planning medical infrastructure development include taking account of territorial planning schemes containing maps of health facility locations that ensure access to medical organizations and patient routing in accordance with medical care procedures, and creating or developing transport infrastructure, including public transport routes, to health facilities.
units.label: The Social Sphere · “Specific features of planning medical infrastructure…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: Medical infrastructure is created as a priority in anchor settlements in accordance with the general principles of social infrastructure development, while retaining opportunities to develop it in adjacent territories where a need exists, provided that the need for that infrastructure in anchor settlements has been met. Priority is given to creating medical infrastructure in anchor settlements with populations of up to 100 thousand on the basis of central district hospitals and district hospitals, including primary vascular departments, oncology care centers, admission departments, women’s consultation clinics, regional and interdistrict (district) centers providing medical care to patients with carbohydrate metabolism disorders and diabetes mellitus, and units providing medical rehabilitation care.
units.label: The Social Sphere · “Medical infrastructure is created as a priority in anchor…”

units.locator: The Social Sphere
units.text: Preschool and general education infrastructure is created as a priority in anchor settlements in accordance with the general principles of social infrastructure development, while retaining opportunities to develop it in adjacent territories where a need exists, provided that the need for that infrastructure in anchor settlements has been met.
units.label: The Social Sphere · “Preschool and general education infrastructure is created as a…”
